name: kemenag-monorepo
description: Website resmi Kementerian Agama Kabupaten Barito Utara — Monorepo (Astro + Go Fiber)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n FE,BE -c cyan,green "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "go -C backend run github.com/air-verse/air@v1.61.7 -c .air.toml"
scripts.build: npm run build:fe && npm run build:be
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n FE,BE -c cyan,green "npm run start:fe" "npm run start:be"
scripts.test: npm --prefix frontend run test && go -C backend test ./...
